summary: Iteration 2: tested True Forgetting (DELETE /api/session + Farewell leave flow) and Gemini TTS chat voice choice (off/female/male) plus regressions. Backend 33/33 pytest pass (incl. 6 new). Frontend: all requested flows pass end-to-end with network verification.

issues: Root uses min-h-screen so with a long conversation the whole page scrolls and the top bar + 'echo replies in' voice choice row scroll out of view (observed after 2 replies at 1920x1080). Consider h-screen with only chat-messages scrolling.

action_items: Optional: make chat layout h-screen so voice choice/top bar stay visible
Optional: in speakReply distinguish audio.play() NotAllowedError (autoplay) from TTS failure; currently both show 'Voice is resting' notice
Optional: revoke previous object URL (URL.revokeObjectURL) before assigning a new audio src
critical_code_review_comments: AIChatScreen.speakReply: any play() rejection (autoplay policy) shows misleading 'Voice is resting' notice even when TTS returned 200
AIChatScreen.speakReply: object URLs never revoked -> small memory leak across many replies
AIChatScreen.speakReply: race - a slower earlier TTS response can start playing after a newer reply's audio
Sessions abandoned without pressing 'leave the room' are kept forever; consider a Mongo TTL index on messages/vents/sessions to match the 'room forgets' promise
nol_chat_speak_v1 / nol_voice_pref_v1 survive 'leave the room' (preferences only, acceptable)
seed_data_creation: None; test sessions created via API (TEST_ prefixed messages deleted via DELETE /api/session)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: DELETE /api/session/{id} returns counts and history becomes []; idempotent for unknown id. /api/voice/speak female+male -> 200 audio/wav RIFF; invalid voice 422; empty text 400. UI: splash shows 'enter the room' after leave; new session code generated; Echo shows empty state. chat-speak-off default; off -> 0 speak requests; female/male -> exactly one POST /api/voice/speak with matching voice param, status 200, no chat-voice-notice (headless autoplay worked). Selection persists after reload. Voice screen picks set nol_voice_pref_v1. home-voice-btn reads 'talk to echo out loud'. Empty room vent + exit modal stay/leave OK.
